_about: Scene sound library. One entry = one scene's music recipe. Used with music:'scenes' and shot field scene:'name' in story.js. New scene names get a recipe created and saved here automatically (tools/scene-audio.js). Listen: node tools/scene-audio.js preview

mood-calm.desc: default for calm scenes: soft pad + gentle bansuri

mood-joy.desc: default for happy scenes: light plucks + soft shaker

mood-hope.desc: default for hopeful scenes: rising harp + flute

mood-divine.desc: default for divine scenes: choir-like pad + temple bells

mood-sad.desc: default for sad scenes: slow bowed strings, sparse
